Also see Veritasium's excellent episode, Is Spider Web really stronger than Steel? - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wt4p2oalmRY

It features a company with a cool technique where Spider Silk DNA is inserted into Silkworm's DNA so you can easily farm them.

Would it be uneconomical to make clothes from spider silk?
But I'm curious what kind of spider Spider Man's web comes from.
We've gotten very good at designing materials, but nature still has a few manufacturing tricks we haven't figured out
